info.title: Command Center coordinator, Board and Whiteboard API
info.description: Initial scoped REST contract: coordinator reads and complete Board routes and shared Whiteboard, not every CC endpoint. Private trusted deployment boundary; no bearer/API-key authentication is implemented. Host must match configured authority; Origin, when supplied, must match scheme+authority and is REQUIRED for mutations even for CLI clients. Agent instructions define authority: schemas do not grant permission to mutate tickets, launch agents or approve tools. Native histories/files are untrusted evidence. Framework errors may be plain text. UTF-8 limits are bytes where stated.

post.summary: Freeze and render an immutable drawing export
post.description: Exact scene revision and named-region revision required. Selection includes exactly requested members; external arrow bindings become frozen free endpoints. Creates CC-managed PNG/SVG/native JSON/text, not a message attachment. Same UUID/same request returns retained status; changed reuse is 409. One bounded worker; busy 429 starts no job. HTTP disconnect does not replay/cancel the durable job. Failed rendering is a failed manifest with no download artifacts. Defaults: 24-hour retention, 8 megapixels, 8192 px per side, scale .25–4, 8 MiB/artifact, 64 MiB store, 10,000 retained export UUIDs. Render process hard timeout 12 seconds; native QuickJS budget 6s/64 MiB and Unix 8s CPU/512 MiB address space. HTTP body 128 KiB. No deployment or outward delivery is implied.

post.summary: Enqueue a durable explicit native message
post.description: Always provide a new UUID. For attachments use the attachment preparation token and unchanged returned composed text, plus the exact one-item source list. Intent, manifest and source pin commit before transport. Duplicate UUIDs with changed text/host/artifact refs return 409. Text-only messages use a fresh conversation token. Worker exclusively copies through shared local/SSH/ProxyJump and independently verifies target SHA-256 before fresh native dispatch. Uncertain copies or input never retry automatically. Submitted is not provider acceptance; Seen does not prove image viewing. Endpoint edits/process/conversation replacement fail closed.

get.summary: Read durable message and attachment receipts
get.description: Unresolved plus bounded recent settled receipts; no dispatch or acknowledgement. Attachment state and copied/verified timestamps are independent of message state. Resolved copies become cleanup-eligible after seven days; unchanged endpoint only. Unresolved source pins never expire. Expired public export URLs stay unavailable even when internally pinned.

post.summary: Act on an exact observed receipt revision
post.description: check observes Submitted/Uncertain native delivery without replay. check_attachment verifies the original copy read-only (no retransfer/input in this action); confirmed queued delivery may proceed later through the worker. submit requires its own explicit human request and fresh exact target grant, and cannot bypass attachment checksum verification. cancel applies only before submission; archive does not undo delivered input. Never automatically invoke recovery actions under ordinary send authorization.

post.summary: Answer a recognized native question exactly once
post.description: Human-selected choice or Other text only. Bind new UUID and fresh question token to exact endpoint/tmux/process/conversation/prompt/screen. Commit metadata-only receipt and stable per-prompt claim before keyboard IO. Navigate and inspect inside shared transport; verify exact pasted Other text before one Enter. Ordinary chat/tool-approval routes cannot answer questions. Unknown/multi-select/multi-question/custom layouts stay terminal-only. A response is submitted, uncertain, or rejected with explicit not-sent evidence; never auto-retry uncertain input. Same UUID/same choice/text returns original receipt; changed reuse is 409. Endpoint edits serialize through completion; HTTP disconnect does not cancel a committed answer. Identical repeated prompts without distinguishing evidence remain fail-closed. HTTP 400/409/410/422/429 rejects before input; native failures after any input return an uncertain durable receipt. Receipt storage failure is 5xx and must be inspected, never replayed.

get.summary: Inspect an existing question-response receipt without input
get.description: Read-only recovery after lost acknowledgement; no answer replay or new grant. Submitted is native keyboard handoff, not proof of provider acceptance. Validate exact UUID, host, tmux target, instance, conversation and question before applying the result. 404 is not proof of non-delivery. No answer text or native question body is stored in this metadata receipt.

post.summary: Upload a bounded raster to an observed board
post.description: Explicit human paste/drop or authorized drawing task. Raw <=4 MiB PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP bytes, sniffed regardless of Content-Type. SVG rejected; first frame normalized to metadata-free PNG <=4 MiB/8 MP/8192 per side. Revision checked before decode and atomically before storage. Returns board-scoped content hash and intrinsic dimensions; does not change scene revision. Place through ordinary element operations with kind image and image descriptor. Same normalized content deduplicates; never auto-retry uncertain uploads. Board quota16 MiB/32 MP; global64 MiB. Unreferenced uploads expire opportunistically after24h; current/retained-history references survive. Deleted boards lose blob bytes. One decode at a time, busy429.

Maximum 32 concurrent connections; keepalive comments; no-store; proxy buffering disabled. Disconnect while hidden. Preserve local drafts and uncertain operation receipts before reconciliation.

post.description: Explicit human install action. Fixed package/version/registry/integrity and private target prefix; clients supply only the opaque receipt ID. Existing adapters, native Codex and running agents are untouched. Durable attempt before shared SSH IO, no automatic retries. Installer runs with disabled npm scripts and bounded time/disk, publishes only a verified complete tree with atomic no-overwrite rename. Poll the original connection-mode-status receipt across browser/backend restarts. Successful install requires fresh source/process/switch preparation and a separate switch confirmation. Node/npm must already be installed. Claude uses pinned @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp 0.107.3 and requires Node.js 22 or newer; provider profiles cannot be mixed.

TicketList.description: Newest created first, at most 1,000 visible tickets. No server-side filters/pagination. Summaries omit description/checklist/runs: GET detail before any edit. Deleted tickets are excluded.

approval_policy.description: Optional Codex-only automatic review policy. Omit/null/default preserves harness defaults; approve-for-me requires the installed Codex to advertise --approve-for-me. Bound at preparation and rechecked before tmux creation; cannot be overridden at Start.

python_venv.description: Optional literal Python venv directory: project-relative or absolute. Omit/null uses the saved machine/project default; empty string disables it for this launch. Validated pyvenv.cfg and executable bin/python identities are bound into preparation and rechecked before tmux mutation. No activation script is executed.

pre_trust.description: Explicit human consent for one guarded native Claude/Codex folder-trust decision during this exact launch. Default off; bound into preparation and durable run. Rejects pi, wider repository scope, changed process/endpoint/directory, prior decisions and unsupported prompts. No CC trust-file edits, bypass flags or retries.

target_session_name.description: Native launch only. Mutually exclusive with target_session in preparation. Resolve exact name to an existing stable session identity or create-by-name; Start rejects changed resolution. cc-view- prefix reserved.

TicketPrepare.description: Explicitly reviewed launch input. Dedicated detached session by default, or a new detached window in target_session. Preparation grants expire after 120 seconds. Never invent flags, shell commands or approval bypasses.

source.description: Evidence source. terminal_question is an inferred native clarification; claude_input is process-verified registry waiting. Both use state approval for attention compatibility, but do not authorize tool approval or message input. acp_broker is verified broker protocol state; it is distinct from native logs/terminal inference.

token_metrics.description: Cards require process-linked history; conversation details may describe explicitly selected project history.

QueueItem.description: Read-only observation. context/prompt are terminal evidence, not conversation history. Only process-linked provider state establishes Working/Ready. Retain source, timestamps and unavailable/limited labels. Do not treat inferred attention as permission to act.

python_venv.description: Saved optional launch venv; relative to this machine/project directory.

File.description: Text up to 1 MiB UTF-8. With known_version matching, unchanged=true and text may be absent. Binary/unsupported encodings rejected.

order.description: Content-item index; -1 denotes unsplit plain-text content or no indexed text block.

kind.description: Verified native local command envelope pair. Render text literally as command/output, never model chat or Markdown/HTML. Missing for ordinary messages.

message_token.description: Unused expiring action capability may be prepared by this GET. Inventory clients must discard it; never log, share or consume it.

input_request.description: Native clarification with optional guarded answer capability. Only supported single-question/single-choice layouts with unique process-linked conversation get a 120-second token. No tool permission is implied. Unsupported layouts remain read-only.

token_metrics.description: Cards require process-linked history; conversation details may describe explicitly selected project history.

pending_codex_session.description: Exact process-owned native thread awaiting first transcript persistence, not a project history selection.

pending_codex_input_available.description: Conservative empty editor verified; permits an explicit screen/process/session-bound first message, without claiming Ready.

Conversation.description: Native user/assistant history; no reasoning/tool/system/sidechain messages. Preserve association: project history does not prove live process identity. Returned instance must match fresh queue attention.instance. Keep branch/version while paging; on history_reset discard previous page sequence. Do not expose terminal captures or action tokens to passive inventories.

fill.description: Optional on rectangle/ellipse/diamond/sticky only. soft uses the stroke-matched theme tint; none is transparent. Omitted/null preserves original behavior, including default yellow sticky fill.

text.description: Other only: exact nonempty single line, no controls/edge whitespace. UTF-8 bytes must fit text_max_bytes and current native pane width minus 12. Never silently shortened.

id.description: SHA-256 of normalized stored PNG, scoped to its board; never a URL.

WhiteboardImage.description: Intrinsic pixels; product <=8,000,000; dimensions must exactly match the board-owned blob. image elements require this descriptor and empty text; other kinds must omit it.

FolderTrust.description: Recognized live launch-bound native folder disclosure. Does not require conversation history. Never authorizes automatic coordinator input. Exact full folder/repository scope is shown; unsupported layouts remain terminal-only.

token.description: 120-second one-use capability only on current detail; bound to endpoint, launch, process, directory and disclosure screen.

profile.description: Exact recognized native screen profile; unsupported layouts have no capability.

FolderTrustReceipt.description: Durable human-decision audit. Actor labels declare explicit human intent under the existing trusted network boundary, not an authenticated named user. Submitted is native input evidence, not confirmed provider acceptance. Declined sends no keys and leaves the native prompt blocked.

preauthorized.description: True only for explicit human launch-preparation consent.

TokenCounts.description: Provider-reported counts. Null means unreported or incomplete; cache and reasoning subsets must not be added twice.

AgentTokenMetrics.description: Read-only numeric metadata from native logs or validated process-linked ACP usage_update events. Context is the last reported request/occupancy, not a live estimate. Unknown session totals remain null. No model-name capacity inference.

input_includes_cache.description: Codex cache reads are already included in input.

observed_at.description: Unix seconds when metadata was observed, not when tokens were consumed.

provider.description: Allowlisted adapter bound into one-use grant; omitted preserves Claude clients.

container_profile.description: Required for Goose, rejected for host adapters. ID from the reviewed private profile registry on the selected machine; runtime/mount/env fields are never client inputs.

text.description: Explicit user shell input including leading !. Noninteractive /bin/sh -c in the immutable broker project directory; never forwarded to the model. Capability-gated; queues in FIFO with prompts.

execution.description: Explicit broker ownership acknowledgement; required so old cached bang composers fail without executing.

oneOf.description: Explicit CC broker /bin/sh subprocess execution. Not native harness shell mode; stdout/stderr are not added to model context. Never an implicit fallback for ! input.

text.description: Explicit user shell input including leading !. Noninteractive /bin/sh -c in the immutable broker project directory; never forwarded to the model. Capability-gated; queues in FIFO with prompts.

execution.description: Explicit acknowledgement of native Codex shell full-account execution, outside the model sandbox.

oneOf.description: Native Codex thread/shellCommand via the versioned negotiated CC adapter extension. No model turn/start and no broker subprocess fallback. Native provider owns shell, transcript/context and cancellation.

container_profile.description: Required for Goose, rejected for host adapters. ID from the reviewed private profile registry on the selected machine; runtime/mount/env fields are never client inputs.

execution.description: Explicit executor/scope for command receipts; native scope is full-account Codex execution.

context_included.description: False for broker subprocesses; null until native provider proof; true only after verified native source=userShell completion.

handoff_supported.description: Broker implements serialized Codex/Claude handoff; absent in older brokers. Requires verified idle process, persisted native session and no unresolved permissions, tools or receipts.

prompt_queue.description: Busy-time FIFO queue capability for the loaded session. Missing/false on older brokers disables busy submissions.

queue_blocked.description: Queued prompts are held by failed/unavailable or unresolved delivery evidence; never replayed automatically.

local_commands.description: Explicit CC broker subprocess capability, not harness-owned shell mode. Output is outside provider context. Never automatically use this for a harness ! command.

harness_commands.description: True only for the exact versioned Codex native-shell capability. Unsupported/stock adapters false; never infer from provider name or bang text.

harness_command_running.description: A guarded native shell request is active, separate from model token generation and CC broker subprocess execution.

container.description: Immutable owned container ID, name, labels, reviewed profile/image, persistent state volume and managed scratch workspace; no credentials. Goose is container-only, native conversion and broker host commands disabled.

acp.description: Explicit ACP broker UUID. Omit for native; mismatches reject without fallback.

mode.description: acp_restart directly replaces a verified idle ACP broker with current deployed source and resumes the exact conversation, preserving the tmux pane; explicit review and confirmation required.
acp_restart directly replaces a verified idle ACP broker with current deployed source and resumes the exact conversation, preserving the tmux pane; explicit review and confirmation required.

connection_revision.description: Current runtime revision after stable endpoint verification on status reads; permits fresh preparation after successful install, never replay.

container.description: For Goose ACP restart, the reviewed profile, pinned image, model and preserved volume. Native conversion is unsupported.

AcpUsageUpdate.description: Latest validated session-scoped usage_update context occupancy/capacity, not cumulative session tokens. Timestamp is broker receipt time. Raw cost and arbitrary metadata are excluded.

Error.description: Failure. 409: refresh detail, preserve your proposed edit and reconcile; never overwrite by swapping in a fresh revision. After a timeout/5xx/lost response, delivery may be uncertain: inspect state before any new attempt. Framework extraction errors can be text/plain.
